cues.en: In this video, I will introduce you to a phenomenon called In-context learning of which zero shot,
cues.zh: 這支介紹語境學習，其中零樣本、

cues.en: one shot, two shot, few shot, and so on are specific examples.
cues.zh: 單樣本、雙樣本、少樣本等，是具體例子。

cues.en: Briefly, In-context learning, which is often abbreviated to ICL, means that large models can do tasks
cues.zh: 簡稱 ICL，意思是大型模型能執行

cues.en: that they have never been trained on and don't need any fine tuning on.
cues.zh: 從沒受訓、也不用微調的任務。

cues.en: It is a curious and remarkable observation that models are even capable of this, and it's also a very
cues.zh: 模型竟有這種能力，很奇妙、很驚人，也很

cues.en: powerful technique, because it means that you can train models to do tasks without having to access
cues.zh: 強大，因為不用存取

cues.en: their weights, or use any computational resources other than a forward pass.
cues.zh: 權重，也不需前向傳播以外的運算，就能教模型做任務。

cues.en: But the flip side of this coin is that in-context learning makes AI safety even more difficult, because
cues.zh: 但另一面，是 AI 安全更困難，因為

cues.en: it means that people can train models to do things that the models were not specifically trained to do.
cues.zh: 人能讓模型做原本沒特別訓練的事。

cues.en: So yeah, in-context learning means getting models to do something that they've never had any training for.
cues.zh: 所以，語境學習就是讓模型做從沒受訓的事。

cues.en: All you have to do is give them a prompt and some examples.
cues.zh: 只要給提示與幾個例子。

cues.en: In fact, sometimes you don't even need to prompt the models.
cues.zh: 有時甚至不用提示指令，

cues.en: You can just show some examples and ask for an output.
cues.zh: 只展示例子，再請它輸出。

cues.en: It is a remarkable, mysterious and initially unexpected capability of these large models.
cues.zh: 這是大型模型驚人、神祕、最初未預期的能力。

cues.en: It's not something that was predicted in advance, but instead discovered through experimentation and exploration.
cues.zh: 並非事先預測，而是實驗、探索中發現。

cues.en: And basically, ICL means that you do not need to fine tune the model to get it to learn a new task, at least for a relatively simple, straightforward instructable.
cues.zh: 基本上，不微調也能學新任務，至少對相對簡單、直接、可用指令描述，

cues.en: Tasks that don't require a lot of tokens.
cues.zh: 又不需太多詞元的任務。

cues.en: Now, depending on the complexity of the task.
cues.zh: 依複雜度，

cues.en: You might not even need to use so many tokens to get the model to understand a moderately difficult classification, summarization, or translation problem.
cues.zh: 可能用不多詞元，就能理解中等難度的分類、摘要、翻譯問題。

cues.en: And this is important because you cannot access the weights of frontier models like commercial models from OpenAI or Google or Meta.
cues.zh: 這很重要，因為無法取得 OpenAI、Google、Meta 商用前沿模型的權重。

cues.en: But ICL also poses some difficulties for AI safety, because it is impossible for the engineers who
cues.zh: 但也帶來安全困難，因為開發者

cues.en: develop the models to guarantee safety in their model when they have no idea what the capabilities of the model are.
cues.zh: 不知道模型經過

cues.en: After some in-context learning.
cues.zh: 語境學習後有什麼能力，就無法保證安全。

cues.en: So the concern is that a bad actor could figure out a way to use in-context learning to bypass the safety
cues.zh: 擔憂是，惡意者可能用語境學習，繞過模型內建、

cues.en: mechanisms that are built into and trained into.
cues.zh: 訓練出的安全機制。

cues.en: So that is in-context learning.
cues.zh: 這就是語境學習。

cues.en: When people talk about in-context learning, they often refer to shots.
cues.zh: 談它時，常會說 shot。

cues.en: This is not like trying to get drunk as quickly as possible on your birthday shots.
cues.zh: 不是生日那種拼命喝酒的 shot。

cues.en: Here refers to the number of examples that you give to the model in the prompt.
cues.zh: 而是提示中給模型的範例數。

cues.en: So a zero shot learning means that you just give a description to the model with no training data.
cues.zh: 零樣本，只描述任務，不給訓練資料，

cues.en: So no examples.
cues.zh: 也就是不給例子。

cues.en: And then one shot learning means you describe the task and give one training example and so on.
cues.zh: 單樣本，描述任務，再給一個例子，依此類推。

cues.en: In general you can say that zero shot is when there's no training data and few shot is when there is a relatively small number of training examples.
cues.zh: 一般說，zero-shot 沒範例，few-shot 則有少量範例。

cues.en: Let me show you an example.
cues.zh: 看個例子。

cues.en: This is a screenshot of a dialogue that I had with ChatGPT.
cues.zh: 這是我與 ChatGPT 對話的截圖。

cues.en: I gave no instructions, but just three training examples here with outputs.
cues.zh: 沒給指令，只有三個附輸出的例子。

cues.en: So the idea is basically just to reformat a date string, and then the final input I gave afterwards was the text output with no actual text afterwards.
cues.zh: 基本上是改日期字串格式；最後輸入「output」，後面不附實際內容。

cues.en: And the reply from ChatGPT was to figure out the pattern and give the correct output.
cues.zh: ChatGPT 自己找出模式，給正確輸出。

cues.en: Now I have to say that this might not be a pure example of in-context learning, because I modified this example from something that's already published on the web.
cues.zh: 但這可能不是純粹的語境學習，因為例子改自網路已有內容。

cues.en: So it actually is possible that ChatGPT has already learned about In-context learning and has learned
cues.zh: 所以，ChatGPT 可能早就學過語境學習，

cues.en: about this specific example, or at least ones that look very similar to this.
cues.zh: 也學過這個例子，或相似的。

cues.en: And that's the thing about models that are trained on web text.
cues.zh: 用網路文字訓練，就是這樣。

cues.en: Once a test or an evaluation or an exploration is published on the web, the frontier models will have
cues.zh: 測試、評估、探索一旦放上網，前沿模型

cues.en: that incorporated into their training set within months or maybe a year.
cues.zh: 幾個月、或一年內，就會納入訓練集。

cues.en: but you can also test in-context learning yourself.
cues.zh: 你也能自己測試。

cues.en: One way to do it is to make up fake names of fake fruits, and then you can make up a description of the flavor of those fruits and where they are grown.
cues.zh: 可以編造水果名字，描述口味、產地。

cues.en: And then you can ask, whatever is your favorite chatbot to predict which of those made up fruits someone would prefer if they like grapes more than apples, for example.
cues.zh: 再請喜歡的機器人預測，例如偏好葡萄勝過蘋果的人，會喜歡哪種假水果。

cues.en: Of course, you want to design your prompts and examples in a way that there is a clear, correct answer.
cues.zh: 當然，提示與例子應該有清楚正解。

cues.en: Otherwise, you're just getting the model to display some randomness and creativity.
cues.zh: 否則只是在讓模型展現隨機性、創造力。

cues.en: There's a whole interesting body of research on in-context learning why it might happen, what the upper limit of the in-context abilities might be.
cues.zh: 語境學習為何發生、能力上限在哪，有很多有趣研究。

cues.en: The main reason I mention it here is so that you are aware of the name for this phenomenon, and how it makes AI safety more challenging.
cues.zh: 這裡主要讓你知道現象名稱，以及為何讓 AI 安全更有挑戰。
